title: Flabby arms workout at home
intro: Arm exercises like tricep dips can strengthen and shape the muscles at the back of your arms. But arm fat can't be burned from one spot only. Fat comes off from the whole body through how you eat and move daily, so this exercise helps your arms look firmer as your weight goes down.
muscles: Triceps (back of the upper arm), front of the shoulders and a bit of the chest muscles.
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair that doesn't move. Place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Move your hips forward until they're off the chair. Knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Slowly bend your elbows backwards and lower your body until your elbows are about 90 degrees.
Push through your palms to come back up until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your chest open throughout the move.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides. Make sure your elbows point backwards.
Going down too deep until your shoulders hurt or feel pulled.
Using your legs to push your body up. Let your arms do the work.
easier: Do wall push-ups with your hands close together (diamond) on the wall, or do dips with your feet closer to the chair and go down only halfway.
harder: Straighten your legs out in front, or lower slowly in 3 seconds and come up in 1 second.
dose: 2 to 3 sets, 8 to 12 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets. Do this 2 to 3 times a week, not on back-to-back days.
safety: Stop if you feel sharp pain in your shoulders, elbows or wrists. If you have a history of shoulder injury, get advice from a doctor or physiotherapist first.

faq.q: How long until my arms look less flabby?
faq.a: Everyone is different. It depends on your eating, daily activity and overall body weight. Staying consistent for a few weeks usually makes your arms feel stronger first before you see changes.

faq.q: If I do 100 dips a day, will arm fat go away faster?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Lots of exercise on one area doesn't burn fat only there. It works better to combine full-body exercise, walking and watching your food portions.

faq.q: Can I use an office chair with wheels?
faq.a: Not recommended because it can slip. Use a four-legged chair, a sturdy bench or the edge of a low sofa.
